description: Core engine hardening in kosty/core and session_utils: registry duplicate guard (Q1.3), canonical single max_workers default (Q5.2), loader fail-closed opt-in strict mode + surfaced unlisted-plugin warning (S2.1), loader manifest-root consistency + tolerant parser (S2.3/S2.4), session_utils access-key hash (S1.3) and config auth-error message sanitization (S1.4). Must not break the existing offline test in tests/test_config_honoring.py.
steps: Q1.3: in kosty/core/registry.py register(), before assigning self._checks[check_id], detect an existing check_id and surface it (append to a new registry-level warnings list AND/OR warnings.warn) instead of silently overwriting at line ~64. Do NOT print to stdout (business layer). Keep the decorator returning the function unchanged. Add a way to read the warnings (e.g. a `warnings` property).

Q5.2: add DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS = 5 as a module constant in kosty/core/config.py and reference it from DEFAULT_CONFIG['max_workers']. Then reference the value 5 consistently: kosty/cli/__init__.py CLI group --max-workers (already 5 — leave or import the constant), kosty/cli/utils.py common_options --max-workers (currently default=10 -> change to 5 / the constant), kosty/core/engine.py ScanEngine.__init__ (currently max_workers=10 -> 5 / the constant). Import direction config<-engine<-cli is safe (config imports nothing from them).

S2.1: in kosty/core/loader.py add an opt-in strict mode. Keep the DEFAULT permissive (unlisted plugin = warn and allow) so local contributors are not blocked by a stale manifest. Add a parameter/flag (e.g. load_directory(..., strict: bool=False)) and plumb a `strict_plugins` config key through. In strict mode, an unlisted file (manifest present, file not in it) must be refused (return False / not loaded). In ALL modes, ensure the 'not in manifest' warning reaches the user, not just self._errors shown under --debug (e.g. route via the loader errors that the engine already surfaces, and make the engine/cli print loader warnings to stderr at the CLI boundary). Plumb strict through kosty/core/engine.py load_plugins and kosty/cli/utils.py _ensure_plugins_loaded. Add the strict_plugins key to DEFAULT_CONFIG + validation in config.py.

S2.3: in loader.py record the manifest root actually used. In load_directory/_load_manifest store self._manifest_root = path when the manifest is loaded, and in _verify_plugin compute rel_path relative to self._manifest_root instead of relying on _import_module walking up the tree to re-discover the manifest dir. Keep behavior identical when path is the manifest root (the current case).

S2.4: in loader._load_manifest replace the fixed `parts = line.split('  ', 1)` (line ~132) with tolerant parsing: split on whitespace (maxsplit=1), and strip a leading '*' (sha256sum binary-mode marker) from the path component. A line like '<digest> *check_x.py' or digest+tab+path must parse to (digest, path).

S1.3: in kosty/providers/aws/session_utils.py _session_key (lines ~38-44), replace the clear access-key prefix with hashlib.sha256(resolved.access_key.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] combined with the token flag, so no raw AKIA/ASIA prefix is held in memory as a dict key. Keep the fallback to str(id(session)).

S1.4: in kosty/core/config.py get_aws_session auth error handling (the two except blocks around lines 316-343), log type(e).__name__ plus a filtered/short message instead of the raw exception. (Note: these are currently print() to stdout; FEAT-005 removes business-layer print() — here just change WHAT is logged; FEAT-005 changes WHERE. If you prefer, route to stderr now to avoid rework.)
acceptance_criteria: Registering two checks with the same check_id surfaces a warning/raise rather than silently dropping the first.
A single canonical max_workers default (5) is referenced by config.DEFAULT_CONFIG, the CLI group, common_options, and ScanEngine; no stray default=10 for max-workers remains.
Loader default still allows an unlisted plugin (with a surfaced warning); strict mode refuses it. Hash mismatch is still refused in both modes.
loader uses self._manifest_root for rel_path; manifest parsing accepts whitespace/tab separators and a leading '*' path marker.
session_utils._session_key contains a sha256[:12] digest, not the raw access-key prefix.
config auth-error logging uses type(e).__name__ and a filtered message, not the raw exception.

Read registry.py, loader.py, session_utils.py, config.py to confirm each change.
findings:
Cross-feature notes for downstream features:
- Canonical worker constant: kosty.core.config.DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS = 5. Referenced by config.DEFAULT_CONFIG['max_workers'], ScanEngine.__init__ default, cli/__init__.py CLI group --max-workers, and cli/utils.py common_options --max-workers + the two _resolve_scan_params fallbacks. No max-workers default=10 remains in the worktree kosty/cli or kosty/core.
- Strict plugin mode: config key 'strict_plugins' (bool, default False) added to DEFAULT_CONFIG + validation in config.py (DEFAULT_STRICT_PLUGINS constant). Plumbed as a `strict` kwarg: PluginLoader.load_directory(..., strict=False), ScanEngine.load_plugins(..., strict=False). EngineScanner reads self.strict_plugins from config_manager.get('strict_plugins', False); cli/utils._ensure_plugins_loaded(strict, debug) reads it from config_manager too. Hash mismatch is still refused in both modes; unlisted file is warn-and-allow by default, refused in strict.
- Loader warning surfacing: new PluginLoader.warnings property (list[str]) and ScanEngine.loader_warnings property. Unlisted-plugin notices now go to loader._warnings (not _errors). Surfaced to stderr at the CLI boundary by EngineScanner._load_plugins and cli/utils._ensure_plugins_loaded, each printing both engine/loader warnings and registry.warnings with a '⚠️  plugin loader:' / '⚠️  registry:' prefix.
- Loader manifest root: PluginLoader now records self._manifest_root in load_directory and _verify_plugin(filepath) computes rel_path against it (no more tree-walk in _import_module). Manifest parser is tolerant: splits on first whitespace run (handles two-space, tab) and strips a leading '*' binary-mode marker.
- Registry duplicate guard: CheckRegistry.register() now detects an existing check_id and appends to CheckRegistry._warnings AND emits warnings.warn(stacklevel=2) before overwriting; exposed via registry.warnings property. NOTE: tests/test_config_honoring.py imports check modules directly after the loader already imported them under a different module prefix (kosty_plugins.* vs kosty.providers.*), so UserWarning duplicate messages appear during the test run. Tests still pass (12 passed). This is expected; in production a single module prefix is used so no real duplicate fires.
- session_utils._session_key now uses hashlib.sha256(access_key)[:12] + token flag (no raw AKIA/ASIA prefix); fallback str(id(session)) kept.
- config auth errors: new module-level _summarize_auth_error(exc) returns 'type(e).__name__: <first line, truncated 200 chars>'; both get_aws_session except blocks now print to stderr using it (FEAT-005 can leave WHERE as-is). 'import sys' added to config.py.
- plugins.sha256 NOT regenerated (final step owns that).
